description: List resource instance addresses in the current Terraform state (terraform state list), optionally filtered. Does not change state: never locks, never refreshes. Credential environment variables are withheld unless the operator sets TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_ALLOW_BACKEND_CREDENTIALS=1, which passes a remote backend its own variables. Instance keys that look secret or equal a sensitive value are hidden. Executes code when any address has a string key: finding sensitive keys runs terraform show, which starts the provider plugins. A non-default workspace that does not exist is refused (reading it would create it).

dir.description: Terraform root module directory (must already be initialized), inside the server's directory or TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_ALLOWED_DIRS. Default: TERRAFORM_CWD_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

filter.description: Case-sensitive substring of the address as printed, e.g. 'module.network' or 'aws_instance.'

id.description: Only the instance whose id attribute equals this (terraform state list -id)

name: tf_state_addresses
